iterations.planner: Parse historical disruption 'Hurricane Harvey Gulf Coast Petrochemical Shutdown' (2017-08-25, high). Map inbound SKUs at Houston to warehouse burn rates. Query Zetaris ERP for open POs and DOIR under 16.8d delay.

params.query: SELECT sku, on_hand, daily_burn, po_eta FROM erp.inventory i JOIN erp.purchase_orders p ON i.sku=p.sku WHERE p.origin_port='Houston' AND disruption_date='2017-08-25'
